lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Prince.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: We can finally be together.
Cinderella?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Yes, it's me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: With you by my side, I shall fight for humanity

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: and be the one to bring forth our beautiful victory.
I know that I can rely on you.
Beautiful as always.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Reliable is a fine thing,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: but I would prefer you use the word "beautiful" instead.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A lovely choice of words.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Everyone shines the brightest when their beauty is at its peak.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Tell me, Prince,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: what are you fighting for?
I fight for everyone who's fighting to reclaim the surface.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A beautiful cause, just like you, Prince.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A beautiful story will be written from it.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: There was a time when I miswrote my own story.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: As a result, I must rewrite it,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: so that it is respectable and beautiful.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: As long as I am by Prince and Grave's side,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I am certain that I will be able to write a new ending, the right ending.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I will do my best to help you,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: so I ask you to help me as well.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: So that my story won't falter.
You can trust me.
Are you sure I can do it?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Wonderful.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's the most beautiful answer.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I must say, such a lack of confidence is truly unappealing.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: When beautiful things come together, your story will never falter.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Believe in yourself.
Will do.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I shall keep in touch,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: my beautiful Prince.
